EC1: 1. Current diagnosis of co-morbid delirium, measured by the Confusion Assessment Measure (CAM) and by clinical diagnosis
EC3: 3. Lifetime [OR] or current diagnosis of Schizophrenia, [OR] Bipolar Disorder [OR] or Schizoaffective Disorder
EC4: 4. Current episode of Major Depressive Disorder (MDD)
EC5: 5. Active substance use disorder within past 6 months
EC6: 6. Treatment with ECT [OR] or other neurostimulation therapies (e.g., TMS or vagal nerve stimulation) within the past 3 months
